programmes.name_local: البرنامج المصري الإسباني للابتكار في تكنولوجيا المعلومات
programmes.amount_note: Joint Egyptian-Spanish programme funding market-led research and technology development projects between Egyptian and Spanish partners. Award sizes are set per call.
programmes.deadline_note: Bilateral calls are issued periodically by ITIDA with the Spanish counterpart agency.
programmes.reopen_note: ESITIP calls are announced on itida.gov.eg; they require a matched Spanish partner, so identifying the partner early is essential.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the joint proposal to the open ESITIP call.
Parallel evaluation by both national agencies.
Funding agreement with each partner funded nationally.

eligibility.other_note: Requires an Egyptian company and a Spanish partner; market-led R&D focus.

programmes.source_snippet: ESITIP is a joint Egyptian-Spanish program designed to fund and support market-led research and tech development.

programmes.funder: Falak Startups (backed by the Egyptian Ministry of International Cooperation / Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise Development Agency)
programmes.amount_note: Investment-plus-acceleration for Egyptian pre-seed and seed startups; Falak invests cash for equity alongside a structured programme. Historical tickets have been in the EGP hundreds of thousands to about EGP 1 million range.
programmes.deadline_note: Cohort-based with application windows announced on falakstartups.com.
programmes.reopen_note: Falak has run multiple cohorts per year; check falakstartups.com or its LinkedIn for the current open call.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online during an open cohort.
Investment, acceleration programme and demo day.

eligibility.other_note: Egyptian startups or startups with a substantive Egyptian presence.

programmes.name_local: برنامج الحضانة - هيئة تنمية صناعة تكنولوجيا المعلومات
programmes.funder: Information Technology Industry Development Agency (ITIDA) and the Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship Center (TIEC), Egypt
programmes.amount_note: ITIDA announced an expanded incubation package increasing total support per startup to EGP 480,000, up from EGP 180,000, combining cash, workspace, technical and business services.
programmes.deadline_note: Cohort-based intakes (TIEC has run winter and summer rounds, including InnovEgypt Winter 2026).
programmes.reopen_note: TIEC runs recurring cohorts of its incubation, InnovEgypt and accelerator (TEA) programmes, typically twice a year. Watch tiec.gov.eg and itida.gov.eg for the next window.

procedure_steps.detail: Monitor tiec.gov.eg for the open incubation or accelerator cohort.
Submit the online application with the product and team description.

documents_required.doc: Egyptian company registration or commitment to register

eligibility.other_note: Egyptian technology startups; some tracks accept pre-incorporation teams and university spin-offs.

programmes.source_snippet: ITIDA recently announced an expanded incubation package that increases total support per startup to EGP 480,000, up from EGP 180,000.
